bio.text: Derek Merrin, a Republican, won the May 2026 primary for Ohio's 9th Congressional District, according to an Associated Press race call, and faces Democratic Rep. Marcy Kaptur in the November general election.

According to his campaign website, he is a former state representative from Lucas County who served eight years in the Ohio legislature, including as chairman of the House Ways and Means Committee in the 134th General Assembly.
The site says he became a Waterville City Council member at age 19 and served as Waterville's mayor from 2008 to 2011.
It says he holds a bachelor's degree from the University of Toledo and a Master of Public Administration from Bowling Green State University, and lives in Monclova Township.

sources.title: Derek Merrin wins GOP primary for Ohio's 9th congressional district, will face Marcy Kaptur in November
